repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Amendment · item 2 corrected (maintainer, 2026-11-23 15:12Z: 「tweetty 编辑布局时，列表视图还是正常显示保存」).

The draft read Twenty wrongly. In Twenty main 86bde5cd, the view bar's 「Reset / Update view」 (`views/components/UpdateViewButtonGroup.tsx`) has no layout-customization check and stays live. The only gate in `RecordIndexPageHeader.tsx` hides the side-panel toggle.

Item 2 now reads as follows. The list draft actions stay available in design mode and are renamed from 「放弃 / 保存」 to 「重置 / 更新视图」; the split menu keeps 「保存为我的视图」. The 编辑应用 refusal for a held list draft is dropped. The acceptance and the title are updated to match. Item 1 is unchanged. The grade is unchanged. The order is still after #36692, serially, because item 1 shares the design-mode state.

triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:build` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:queue` (under #36359) · size M; type set to Bug (was none).
Rationale: design mode and the Configure-tabs editor stack two save bars, and a list draft interacts with design mode differently from the Twenty reading the maintainer ruled (「照 Twenty 归类」). Layout authoring writes page metadata, so `area:build`. Nothing is lost or wrong in stored data; the editing surfaces are confusing, which the table grades p2. Source: maintainer, UI review thread.

Prior rulings read: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 36737` on the surface at b01d8f97 — 32 hit lines in 4 files; the two that bear on this card: `layout/designMode.tsx:51` (#36692, the maintainer's ruling to keep a dashboard's and a report's own editors outside the mode, two entries as Twenty does) and `views/RecordTabsConfig.tsx:37` (#36363 ruling (4), the menu rename precedent for the name field). Neither conflicts: the card's ruled option 「照 Twenty 归类」 moves record tabs into the mode and leaves content editors exclusive. No ADR on the surface.

Note for the dev: the seat could not settle whether a renamed list action adds a key to the published `@object-ui/i18n` language pack (published keys widen the public surface). Reuse existing keys where they fit; if a new key is added, measure it on the built declaration closure and report it, and the `Clause-②:` line is re-read from that.
